title: Intelligence & Automation Engineer
description: About UsSouthern Cross Health Insurance is shaping a healthier Aotearoa New Zealand. Our purpose is simple: empowering our members to live well for longer. We're here to give peace of mind through timely access to quality care, inspire healthier living, and lead positive change across the health system. As a New Zealand-owned, member-based organisation, we're building a future where wellbeing is at the heart of everything we do -- delivering exceptional value for our members and creating an environment where our people thrive.Now is an exciting time to join us. You'll be part of a high-performing, values-driven team where people are at the heart of everything we do -- and in return for your talent, you'll have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and be proud of the difference your work makes.About The RoleSouthern Cross is guided by purpose, powered by people and technology. We exist to help our members live well for longer.We serve almost one million members across Aotearoa New Zealand – which means the work we do carries real scale, real responsibility, and a genuine opportunity to improve health outcomes for our nation.As we grow to be about assurance as well as insurance – a more proactive partner in our members' health – we're building a new Data & AI function from the ground up. This role is part of a small team working out, quickly and practically, what AI and automation can actually do for the business.You'll turn early ideas into working prototypes in days rather than months, so the team has real evidence before committing further investment.About The Role You’ll help turn early ideas into prototypes, builds it and tests whether it actually works. You'll build and test AI agents, automation workflows and integrations, figure out quickly what's genuinely viable, and hand off what's proven so the business can embed and scale it.You'll move between hands-on coding and plain conversations with the business about what's possible. You need to be as comfortable explaining a trade-off to a stakeholder as you are shipping the code behind it.What You'll Do Build and iterate on AI-driven prototypes, scripts and automation workflows Experiment with generative AI tools, agent frameworks and orchestration platforms: Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT and whatever comes next Connect APIs, SaaS tools and data systems to test how a workflow holds up in practice Turn ambiguous business ideas into small, testable technical experiments Work closely with analysts, engineers and business teams to validate concepts fast Document what works, what doesn't, and what's worth taking further Demonstrate working prototypes to stakeholders, so decisions are based on something real What You'll Bring You’ll have strong hands-on experience with generative AI tools and modern LLM-based systems. Experience building integrations through APIs, webhooks and automation platforms A practical understanding of how automated workflows are put together A strong technical AI, ML, software or analytics engineering background, with enough grounding to know what's realistic Good judgement about what's worth testing and what isn't viable Clear communication – you can explain technical feasibility in plain terms, and say when something won't work Curiosity about what's possible in AI, while being pragmatic about solutions Comfortable working without a complete brief, and quick to ship something functional Why join us We're investing – in people, in technology, and in the mission. At a time when the market is hesitant, we're continuing to invest in strengthening our foundations and building our capabilities.We're building something worth joining. Our teams are growing, our employer brand is gaining real traction in market, and the way we show up for our members and each other is being noticed. This momentum has also been reflected externally – in 2026, Southern Cross placed 8th in the Kantar Corporate Reputation Index and 5th in New Zealand for Trust.Who We Are Ngākau nui. Āhurutanga. Tikanga. Join a proud, diverse team that's always there, always real, always true. If you thrive in a caring, honest and open culture, we think you'll love working with us.We know our team's culture and wellbeing drive us forward. That's why we prioritise not only professional development but opportunities to thrive personally. We offer exceptional work/life balance, and our people are encouraged – and rewarded – for living well.Southern Cross Employee Benefits Include: Five days of wellbeing leave per year Health insurance for you and your immediate whānau Life insurance cover and discounts on pet and travel insurance Extra parental leave benefits and financial wellbeing support Participation in our workplace wellbeing programme The option to purchase flexi leave for study, volunteering, or supporting your whānau An annual volunteer day to contribute to a cause with your team This role is Auckland based. While we appreciate interest from candidates in other locations, we're not able to consider remote options at this stage. If this sounds like the kind of work you want to help shape, we'd love to hear from you. Have questions? Check out our FAQs for help with the application and recruitment process.We are proud to have taken the Pride Pledge, reflecting our commitment to inclusion and belonging. We also facilitate an active, employee‑led Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Forum, which includes our Rainbow Network, Māori Network, Pasifika Collective, and Neurodiversity and Whānau Support networks.If you share our commitment and passion, we'd love to hear from you. Show more Show less

title: AI Engineer - UNIQA Agentic AI Platform
description: Popis pracovnej pozícieWhat To ExpectDesign, implement, and improve reusable agent patterns and reference implementations for the UNIQA Agentic AI Platform.Develop agent workflows for recurring architectures such as supervisor, router, multi-agent collaboration, validation, synthesis, interaction, and exception handling.Apply context engineering, prompt design, RAG integration, tool calling, memory, and structured output patterns to reliable enterprise use cases.Build and maintain evaluation datasets, automated quality checks, benchmarks, and deployment quality gates for agents.Support use case and country teams through hands-on implementation, template adaptation, reviews, and knowledge transfer.Identify reusable components from use cases and promote them into centrally governed patterns and libraries.Collaborate with platform framework, architecture, integration, security, data, DevOps, and SRE specialists.Ensure solutions are explainable, testable, observable, secure, and aligned with responsible AI and regulatory requirements.Čo ti ponúkameOd 2 381 EUR/mesiacfrom 2.381 € per month - guaranteed 13th and 14th salary. The base salary starts at €2.381 gross per month, depending on the candidate’s seniority, and is guaranteed to be paid 14 times a year. Are you an early bird, or do you prefer a quiet morning? Thanks to flexible working hours, at UNIQA GSC you can organize your day to suit your needs. We offer new colleagues not only a warm welcome but also a welcome package. Are you curious about what it might contain? To help you eat healthy and hearty meals, we’ll contribute €9.30 toward each lunch. A €200 cafeteria credit—some appreciate the contribution toward sports, others toward massages, culture, books, or medication. We have to keep learning throughout our lives, but thanks to in-house language courses in German and English, along with a language certificate paid for by your employer, it’s a little easier. You can also develop your skills through a wide range of professional training opportunities, which we’re also happy to support. Your salary is fixed, and we’ll even add two extra paychecks. We guarantee all our employees a full 13th and 14th month’s salary. Do you have children? We offer a bonus of €48.40 for each child. You don’t have to worry about a decent retirement. We contribute to our employees’ third-pillar supplementary pension savings. We’ve got your back in case of an accident and provide you with year-round accident insurance. It’s always nice to meet up and chat with colleagues outside of work. That’s why we regularly organize events for employees, such as a Christmas party, a summer festival, a sports day, and various outings. Not only our employees, but also their families will find something to enjoy. Children’s Day, St. Nicholas Day, and many other benefits are a given. Show more Show less
